body: [{"streamId":"01a0ceea-653f-724c-8995-570aa50ce8e3","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a0ceea-653f-724c-8995-570aa50ce8e3\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022When the resolved platform home is not the default ~/.hall9k (HALL9K_HOME set to another directory), h9k install --from-release \\u003Cpayload\\u003E neither creates nor retargets an h9k link in any PATH directory, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, or ~/.local/bin; it prints one line saying the PATH link was skipped because the home is redirected, together with the scratch binary\\u0027s full path to call directly.\u0022,\u0022The same holds for h9k update under a redirected home on macOS, Linux, and Windows: on Windows the guard sits in front of the HKCU Environment\\\\Path prepend (lesson 5082d6bc) and the skip line names the bin directory; on every platform the skip line also says to add it to PATH by hand if this relocated install is meant to be permanent.\u0022,\u0022A default-home install links onto the PATH exactly as today (retarget in place, never clobber a real file, fall back to ~/.local/bin, prepend on Windows), covered by the existing tests; the skip decision is a single question on the platform-paths helper (is the home redirected), and one new unit test sets the test-only home override to a scratch path and proves the finish step skips both the symlink branch and the registry branch, with no real symlink, registry write, or process environment change.\u0022,\u0022docs/operations.md gains a short paragraph beneath the HALL9K_HOME row of its environment table (no isolation paragraph exists today) saying that a redirected home relocates everything on disk and skips the PATH link, so a scratch run under it never touches the live h9k command, and that a permanently relocated install adds its bin directory to PATH by hand.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-09-24T19:04:14.808026\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"854646db-74c6-4aa6-9fb0-b5d41b64c9fd","originSequence":63528,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-09-24T19:04:14.821458+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
